en: Learn English with me at the restaurant in Kuala Lumpur.
zh: 跟我一起在吉隆坡的餐厅学英语。

en: We just booked a table at this restaurant.
zh: 我们刚刚在这家餐厅订了一张桌子。

en: It's called Damascus.
zh: 这家餐厅叫 Damascus。

en: or we made a reservation at this restaurant called Damascus.
zh: 或者也可以说，我们在一家叫 Damascus 的餐厅预约了座位。

en: This is what it looks like.
zh: 它看起来就是这个样子。

en: and they have a takeout spot here.
zh: 他们这里还有一个外带取餐区。

en: You can order your food here and then they make it on the spot for you.
zh: 你可以在这里点餐，然后他们会现场给你做。

en: Look how pretty this looks.
zh: 看，这里看起来多漂亮。

en: Here is the host stand where you can go order takeout, make a reservation.
zh: 这里是接待台，你可以在这里点外带、预约座位。

en: and ask questions and all of that.
zh: 也可以问问题之类的。

en: This is the entrance to the restaurant.
zh: 这里是餐厅的入口。

en: and usually there is a host outside here but there isn't one now.
zh: 通常这里外面会有一位接待员，但现在没有。

en: And what a host does is they check you in, they say hello to you,
zh: 接待员的工作就是帮你办理入座登记，跟你打招呼，

en: they make sure you have the correct reservation at the correct time.
zh: 确认你的预约时间和预约信息都是正确的。

en: So we're gonna go look for one.
zh: 所以我们现在要去找一位接待员。

en: They also have a patio over there or a terrace.
zh: 他们那边还有一个露台，或者说户外平台。

en: where you could just sit outside and look at the view.
zh: 你可以坐在外面看风景。

en: It's a very very busy street here.
zh: 这里是一条非常非常繁忙的街道。

en: There's also a QR code that you can scan and see the menu.
zh: 这里还有一个二维码，你可以扫码查看菜单。

en: and you can choose before you get in or while you're standing in line.
zh: 你可以在进去之前选好，或者排队的时候选。

en: There is a line forming outside here.
zh: 外面这里已经开始排起队了。

en: so this restaurant is quite popular.
zh: 所以这家餐厅相当受欢迎。

en: If you are ever in Kuala Lumpur make sure to check it out.
zh: 如果你以后来吉隆坡，一定要来这里看看。

en: There is a dine-in lineup.
zh: 这里有一条堂食排队通道。

en: which means that you are dining in so you're going inside the restaurant.
zh: 意思是你要在店里用餐，所以你会进入餐厅里面。

en: So these people are going to dine in and then that area is
zh: 所以这些人是要进去堂食，然后那个区域是

en: where you order for takeout or to go.
zh: 点外带或者打包带走的地方。

en: Take away. Or take away.
zh: Take away。也可以说 take away。

en: So we just checked in we got third floor 18th table.
zh: 我们刚刚办理了入座登记，我们被安排在三楼第18桌。

en: so we're gonna go upstairs now but we're gonna wait for these people to go first.
zh: 所以我们现在要上楼，不过我们要先等这些人走过去。

en: This is so beautiful.
zh: 这里太漂亮了。

en: No problem. No worries.
zh: 没关系。没事的。

en: Okay so this's first floor I can smell the food.
zh: 好，这里是一楼，我已经闻到食物的香味了。

en: This is second floor.
zh: 这里是二楼。

en: This restaurant is huge.
zh: 这家餐厅好大。

en: Okay we're at the third level.
zh: 好了，我们到三楼了。

en: Hi there. I got this.
zh: 你好。我来拿这个。

en: Thank you. Corner side.
zh: 谢谢。靠角落的位置。

en: The big one?
zh: 大的那张吗？

en: Yeah. Oh wow thank you so much.
zh: 对。哇，太谢谢你了。

en: So the table that we got seats six people or has six seats.
zh: 所以我们拿到的这张桌子可以坐六个人，或者说有六个座位。

en: It's a good tongue twister.
zh: 这还是个不错的绕口令。

en: Six seats.
zh: Six seats。
